item.description: A 48-year-old Taiwanese doctor who cannot practise medicine in Singapore volunteers at hospitals while being a stay-at-home dad.

item.description: 230 migrant workers in Singapore have been unpaid for up to 2 months and will receive support with meals and job-matching.

item.description: Meta's law enforcement outreach team uses AI and human reviewers to analyze social media posts, aiming to prevent threats like school shootings.

item.title: Three Singapore-registered companies say they will comply with NEA's haze notices
item.description: NEA issued notices to 10 Singapore-registered firms on Friday (Oct 23) seeking documents and information on transboundary haze pollution; three say they will comply.

item.title: Singapore Rail Academy to partner 5 educational institutions to help rail workers gain formal qualifications
item.description: Singapore Rail Academy will partner five educational institutions so rail workers can gain formal qualifications, under a consolidated curriculum.

item.title: I Don't Understand Quantum Physics
Indonesia reduces gas exports to Singapore in order to 'safeguard reliability' of domestic supplies
item.description: Indonesia began reducing natural gas exports to Singapore on Saturday (Oct 24) to divert supplies to domestic electricity needs. The move diverts 31 million standard cubic feet of gas a day from Natuna and Sumatra. Why it matters: Touches Singapore and markets.

item.title: Fancy harnesses make coding agents more expensive but not better, study finds
item.description: A controlled study found switching coding-agent harnesses barely changes pass rates, while cost per task can triple.

item.title: Story3 Capital Partners buys $2.25M in Rent the Runway shares
item.description: Story3 Capital Partners bought $2.25M in Rent the Runway shares, and Nexus Capital Management, a company director, bought $2.25M in stock.

item.title: Researchers Push Over 2 Million Updates to Remotely Disable Popcorn Time Updater That Could Fuel a Botnet
item.description: Eye Security remotely pushed more than 2 million updates to disable an abandoned Time4Popcorn updater that could have let outsiders take over computers.

item.title: Nvidia backs AI video startup Higgsfield in series B extension
item.description: Nvidia backed AI video startup Higgsfield in a series B extension. The funding news came during Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's visit to Kazakhstan. Why it matters: Nvidia-backed funding for an AI video startup, relevant to AI startups and the funding market.

item.title: Brotli Decoder Flaw Behind Node.js RCE Also Affects Bun, Python and Other Widely Used Software
item.description: A memory-corruption flaw in Google's Brotli decoder, tracked as CVE-2026-111497, affects programs including Bun and Python's Brotli packages.

item.title: TikTok’s US unit seeks multiple gigawatts of computing power
item.description: TikTok's US unit seeks multiple gigawatts of computing power, per a job ad for a business-to-business AI product.

item.title: Swiss stocks becoming a haven from AI fears roiling markets
item.description: Switzerland's large-cap SMI index rose 4.6% this month while the euro-area Euro Stoxx 50 fell 3.2%, as investors pare back European risk.

item.title: 360's Zhou Hongyi Says Its Sovereign AI Operating System Is Already in Use at Some Organizations
item.description: Zhou Hongyi of 360 says its sovereign AI operating system, covering compute, models, knowledge bases and an agent factory, is used by some organizations.

Why it matters: Shows AI models being used to find real software vulnerabilities, including PHP2Shell bugs, relevant to cybersecurity and CVEs.

item.title: What next for France as riots rattle markets? Three questions facing investors ahead of more protests
item.description: French unrest pushed borrowing costs to their highest since 2002; Moody's kept France's Aa3 rating with a negative outlook.

item.title: Motorists advised to avoid section of Punggol Way due to risk of flash floods
item.description: Motorists are advised to avoid a section of Punggol Way due to risk of flash floods, as heavy rain is expected from 1.30pm to 2.30pm.

item.title: Moonshot curbs hacking ability in new Kimi model as fears grow over AI-powered cyberattacks
item.description: Moonshot said it reduced the cyber-offensive capabilities of its new Kimi K3.1 Pro model by removing cyber-related data from training.

item.title: Hacker reverses Samsung TV, finds on-board AI listening OpenAI account suspended
item.description: A hacker reverse-engineered a Samsung TV and found that the OpenAI account behind its on-board AI had been suspended.

item.description: Franklin Templeton added about $150 million in tokenized money market fund shares to the XRP Ledger, all held in one wallet.

item.description: A tip for skipping Google's AI Overviews and returning to traditional web search results.

item.description: NVIDIA released Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B 4GB, an open small language model for local voice assistants, game characters and robots.

item.description: Brent crude settled at US$116.72 on Friday, its highest since April 29, after Houthi attacks in Saudi Arabia.

item.description: The Node2Shell flaw has evolved into HTTP2Shell, and its blast radius reaches many HTTP libraries and apps.

item.title: AWS Sold Out Of Capacity Into 2028, Jassy Says
item.description: Amazon Web Services capacity is mostly booked up through at least next year, Amazon CEO Andy Jassy said on an Andreessen Horowitz podcast released on Friday.

item.title: PHP Foundation 'under-funded' with one full-time staff member, director says
item.description: The PHP Foundation, which coordinated fixes for two critical PHP flaws, has one full-time staff member and 14 mostly part-time contractors.

item.description: 22 companies, including Wells Fargo, have objected to having their US stocks tokenized on the proposed OKXICE platform.

item.title: Wall Street closes lower to end rocky week

item.description: Moonshot AI unveiled Kimi K3.1 Pro, a 3T-class open-weight model with a 1M-token context window, and a faster Highspeed version. Full weights are to be released by Nov. 4.
